end.summary: Practised defining physical change as no new substance, with changes in shape, size, or state.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised physical changes using melting ice and chemical changes using curd formation and cooking paranthi. They correctly identified that melting ice does not make a new substance and explained that cooked paranthi cannot return to raw dough. Ananya continued to question whether most changes can be reversed, so this distinction was not fully settled by the end. At home, sort examples into physical or chemical change and note whether a new substance forms.
